name: Ballistic Mage (Legendary Arcanist Archetype)
body:
Although most legendary arcanists have some martial training, a few have achieved synergy between spell and weapon. This synergy allows the legendary arcanist to deliver spells with aerodynamic flair.

Ranged Spellstrike (Ex)

Whenever the ballistic mage casts a spell or uses an arcanist exploit that affects a target at range, they can deliver the spell through a ranged weapon they are wielding as part of a ranged attack. This replaces any free ranged touch attack normally allowed to deliver the spell or exploit (if any).

The attack does not increase the spell’s or exploit’s range. If the attack hits, the target is also affected by the spell or exploit, otherwise, it is wasted.

The spell or exploit can only affect one target when used with a spellstrike, even if it normally affects multiple targets. If the spell or exploit can be used to make multiple attacks against a single target (such as scorching ray), then one spellstrike can deliver all the attacks to the target with one attack roll.

This replaces the arcanist exploit gained at first level.

Arcanist Exploits

The following exploits are available to the ballistic mage:

Black Powder Spellcraft

Requires: proficiency with at least one firearm)

Those ballistic mages that blend mysticism with firearms often call themselves triggermages. As a free action, the triggermage may spend 1 point from their arcane reservoir to prevent a gun from breaking or exploding, or to fix and reload it.

The triggermage adds the following spells to their spell list as part of the universal affinity:

0th—mending, telekinetic projectile
1st—abundant ammunition, alchemical tinkering, damp powder, fabricate bullets, gravity bow, longshot, weaken powder
2nd—bullet ward, destabilize powder, recoil fire, reloading hands, ricochet shot, stabilize powder, thunder fire
3rd—flash fire
4th—named bullet
6th—named bullet, greater
Focused Spellstrike (Su)

The ballistic mage can use ranged spellstrike to deliver a spell or exploit that normally has an area of effect as a ranged attack, affecting only the creature or object struck. That target does not get a Reflex saving throw, even if the spell or exploit used with the spellstrike originally granted one. The spellstrike is still limited to the range of the original spell, unless the ballistic mage also possesses the distant spellstrike exploit.

Reach Spellstrike (Su)

The ballistic mage can deliver spells with a range of touch using ranged spellstrike up to a maximum range of close (25 feet + 5 feet per 2 caster levels).

Greater Exploits

A ballistic mage can select from the following additional greater exploits:

Distant Spellstrike (Su)

The range of any spell or exploit the ballistic mage delivers through a spellstrike increases to the range of the weapon.

Imbued Shot (Su)

The ballistic mage gains the ability to place a ranged area spell upon an arrow or crossbow bolt. When the projectile is fired, where the projectile lands (wherever that may be) is treated as the origin of the spell. You choose which way the spell is directed if it has a shape to it. A spell cast in this way uses its standard casting time and the ballistic mage can fire the arrow as part of the casting. The projectile must be fired during the round that the casting is completed, or the spell is wasted. The spellstrike is still limited to the range of the original spell, unless the ballistic mage also possesses the distant spellstrike exploit.

Seeker Shot (Su)

The ballistic mage may spend 1 point from their arcane reservoir when attacking with a missile weapon against a known target to make their projectile seek their target. The projectile travels to the target, even around corners. This ability negates cover that does not completely surround the target, concealment, armor, and shield modifiers, but otherwise the attack is rolled normally.
